ma.getAuthCode(Object object)

Call the interface to obtain login credentials. Obtain user login status information through credentials (minimum version: 24.3.0)

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
scopes Array Yes scopes list
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Scopes List

Permission Name Permission Description
AUTH_BASE Obtaining the user ID through authorization.
AUTH_USER Authorized to obtain user ID and other user information.
SEND_MESSAGE Authorized to send notifications to the user via SMS, PUSH, or INBOX.
USER_NICKNAME Authorized to obtain the user nickname.
USER_NAME Authorized to obtain the user name.
USER_LOGIN_ID Authorized to obtain the user's login ID.
PLAINTEXT_USER_LOGIN_ID Authorized to obtain the user's plaintext login ID.
HASH_LOGIN_ID Authorized to obtain the hash user login ID.
USER_AVATAR Authorized to obtain the user avatar.
USER_GENDER Authorized to obtain the user's gender.
USER_BIRTHDAY Authorized to obtain the user's birthday.
USER_NATIONALITY Authorized to obtain the user's nationality.
USER_CONTACTINFO Authorized to obtain the user's contact information.
USER_ADDRESS Authorized to obtain the user's address.
PLAINTEXT_MOBILE_PHONE Authorized to obtain the user's plaintext phone number.

object.success Callback Function

Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String getAuthCode: ok
authCode String User login credentials

object.fail Callback Function

Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String error message
errno String error code

Error Code List

Error Scenario Error Code Supported by Android Supported by iOS Supported by Simulator Development Suggestion
Invalid request parameter type. 1 Yes Yes Yes
Invalid value of the request parameter. 2 Yes Yes Yes Check whether the parameter value in the interface invoking parameter is valid (for example, invalid permission) based on errorMsg.
The request parameter is not mandatory. 3 Yes Yes Yes
The permission is unavailable at the current site. 1201000 Yes Yes No Check whether the permission scope in the interface invoking parameter is available at the current site based on errorMsg. (The permission scope can be obtained from Axis Platform operation personnel.)
The user rejects the login-free authorization. 1201001 Yes Yes No Developer-friendly implementation prompts the user to grant related permissions.
The user is not authorized or rejected. 1201002 Yes Yes No Developer-friendly implementation prompts the user to grant related permissions. The Mini Program framework throws a pop-up window when the getAuthCode API is invoked next time.
Failed to query the merchant ID and related credentials configured on the management portal. 1201003 Yes Yes No Contact Axis Platform operation personnel to locate the fault.
The operation personnel on the Mini Program developer side do not configure the merchant ID and related credentials on the management console. 1201004 Yes Yes No The operation personnel on the Mini Program developer side need to configure the merchant ID and related credentials on the Mini Program management console. For details, contact the operation personnel of the Axis Platform.
The host application developer does not implement adaptation related to free login of Mini Program. 1201005 Yes No No Contact the current site operation personnel to obtain the corresponding commissionable host app version.
The callback information is empty or the authorization code authCode field is not returned. 1201006 Yes Yes No Contact the operation personnel of the current site to coordinate with the developer of the host app to locate the fault.
Callback upon a processing failure in the logic of no-login of the host app 1201007 Yes Yes No Contact the current site operation personnel to coordinate with the host app developer to locate the fault.
An internal error occurred in the Mini Program management console. 1201008 Yes Yes No Contact the current site operation personnel to locate the fault.

Usage Restrictions

  1. To use this interface, you need to connect to the Mini Program saas platform
  2. Using this interface requires the host application to implement and inject related functions such as obtaining authorization codes (please refer to the Mini Program SDK Integration Document--Integrating Third-Party Accounts without Login Guidance Chapter)

Sample Code

ma.getAuthCode({
  scopes: [], // The scope of authority is subject to the current site operation definition; this is for illustration purposes only.
  success(res) {
    console.log(res.authCode);
  }
});
